name: Company Crossbow
lore: The Fair Company's crossbows were customs men at Pennyfold before the Charter freed the road, and when the fort was sold they were sold with it, at a fair price, as fixtures. They still stand the towers in the Tallymen's grey with the badge cut off, and they still shoot the way they were taught: at whoever did not stop when told to.

name: Company Blade
lore: A bravo on the Fair Company's books who has not yet made captain's list: a rapier bought on credit, a writ of protection of his own in his coat, and the Company's habit of offering you one before he draws.
